answer: Rotating Task Attestation. Each identity must periodically submit a solution to a fresh, randomly generated challenge whose difficulty is calibrated to recent network load, forming a distinct vertex in a per-round dependency graph. Solutions cannot be copied because the challenge seed embeds the solver's prior transcript hash, making every answer unrepeatable. An attacker cloning identities pays full compute per clone per round, scaling linearly with fleet size.
